overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter delivering premium dehydrated Karela Powder from India. Sourced from selected bitter gourd, the raw botanical undergoes careful cleaning, controlled dehydration, and fine pulverization. The resulting powder offers a consistent 80 to 100 mesh profile with moisture levels strictly maintained below 7.0 percent, ensuring reliable commercial performance.

Our manufacturing follows a disciplined six-step process from farm sourcing to final packing and dispatch. We support global business partners with bulk ingredient supply, OEM manufacturing, and tailored private-label options. With an accessible minimum order quantity of 5 Kg, complete export documentation support, and custom mesh specifications on request, we provide seamless fulfillment for diverse industrial formulations worldwide.
highlights: Fine 80 to 100 mesh size for smooth blending and formulation
Moisture content controlled at or below 7.0 percent
Processed through a disciplined six-step manufacturing system

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Karela Powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 Kg, supporting formulation trials as well as large-scale bulk procurement.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and recommended storage condition?
faqs.a: The product has a shelf life of 24 months when kept in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you offer private labeling and custom mesh sizes?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide OEM manufacturing, custom private-label packaging in jars or pouches, and customized mesh sizes on request.

faqs.q: Can commercial buyers request samples before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available on request to evaluate aroma, mesh uniformity, and formulation suitability.

faqs.q: What manufacturing and processing workflow do you follow?
faqs.a: We operate as an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer utilizing a six-step process: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch.

faqs.q: Do you provide documentation for international shipments?
faqs.a: Yes, as an IEC-registered exporter, we provide comprehensive export documentation support to ensure seamless international transit.
